currency.basis: cifra-bank.ru live homepage (fetched 2026-10-04) operates under ЦИФРА банк branding; CBR registry entry (OGRN 1026500000317) listed among top results; Google Play listing renamed to Цифра банк.

assessment.independenceRationale: Primary asset from bank-controlled domain (official); Google Play only corroborates naming; no third-party vector reused.
uncertainties: Candidate is a path subset of the official wordmark SVG (lossless extraction of the self-contained symbol group), not a standalone symbol file published by the bank; original bytes retained alongside.
Green used by favicon variant is solid green square; footer logo symbol variant is black square with green F; both are current official variants — candidate follows the footer-logo variant.

variant.basis: Extracted candidate is the standalone square symbol (rounded square + F cutout) as used for favicons/app icons; no accompanying wordmark text; square cell suitable.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All symbol details survive: rounded-square contour, corner radius, F cutout proportions, exact green #0AE15F and black fill; no clipping or lost detail at 240px or 24px on either theme.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Source symbol proportions preserved (square viewBox 22.5x22.5, full-bleed rounded square fills the cell); complete emblem fits the square icon cell with useful optical size and no distortion.
candidate.rationale: Replacement needed: the accepted base icon is the former Freedom Finance green-circle 'F' mark; the bank operates as ЦИФРА банк and the official footer logo from job.cifra-bank.ru contains the current standalone symbol (black rounded square, green #0AE15F F). The symbol group was losslessly selected from that original vector.
candidate.role: standalone brand symbol for the ЦИФРА банк catalog icon
transforms: Working candidate derived from the fetched original logo-footer.svg (sha256 c51ef648…) by lossless selection of the self-contained two-path symbol group; viewBox tightened to the symbol bounds (55.5 0 22.5 22.5); no geometry, color or path data changes.

Official footer logo SVG (job.cifra-bank.ru, official careers property) contains the current standalone brand symbol (rounded square with legacy-F cutout, green #0AE15F); symbol extracted losslessly as a self-contained path subset of the original official vector and verified by rendering.

sourceCandidate.rationale: iconHash and path bind the exact fetched original logo-footer.svg (sha256 c51ef648…) from the bank-controlled careers domain; it is the current official ЦИФРА банк wordmark whose self-contained standalone symbol group (green #0AE15F F on black rounded square, viewBox 55.5 0 22.5 22.5) was losslessly extracted for the working candidate and visually verified at 240x240.

sources.observation: Homepage of cifra-bank.ru operates as Цифра банк (rebranded from Freedom Finance); inline header wordmark SVG 'ЦИФРА банк' with Ф rendered as the square symbol; favicon set is PNG only (196x196 favicon shows green square with F-shaped slot).

Official careers site references wp-content/uploads/logo-footer.svg; fetched SVG is an original 190x25 wordmark 'ЦИФРА банк' where the Ф is the standalone brand symbol (black rounded square + green #0AE15F F cutout). Favicon android-icon-192x192-1.png on same property matches the square symbol.
Google Play listing 'Цифра банк' uses package com.bankffin.portfolio (retains former FFIN id), confirming the rebrand lineage; app icon not used (raster).
